ART DIRECTION: RUBBER-HOSE CARTOON
1930s RUBBER-HOSE ANIMATION CARTOON. Huge pie-cut eyes, bouncy curved limbs, simple expressive grin, rounded white cartoon gloves, thick flowing ink lines and a small limited palette of navy, warm ivory, ochre and brick-red. Flat old-animation-cel shapes with light vintage print grain. Silly and lively, without modern realistic anatomy or glossy digital shading.

Use case: logo-brand. Deliver ONE complete playful developer logo / laptop-sticker PNG, with a TRUE transparent alpha background. Keep the entire character, crown, and props within a square composition, with generous transparent margins. A close clean ivory cut-line may follow the scene's actual outer silhouette if appropriate for the medium.
Input image 1 is CHARACTER IDENTITY ONLY. Reinterpret its rendering completely in the requested art style. Keep Atum recognizable through the Egyptian red-and-white double crown, small gold cobra, blue-and-gold striped headdress, warm brown face, and narrow teal ceremonial beard. Computer geometry must make sense: desktop screen fronts face Atum; if the outside back of a laptop lid faces the viewer, it is plain and blank, never painted as a display. Atum is actively typing or writing software. Only one character, no extra people. Compact readable design, no surrounding room, no photo of a real sticker.
